This '''unidentified [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]''' worked for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Bureau of Intelligence]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At some point after [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|the destruction of]] the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]], he infiltrated a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] base, posing as a Rebel leader. He sent the information he obtained straight back to the Empire.
